repairs.quote: Zac bounces 4 times. The first bounce to hit each enemy Knocks them back and deals (120/190/260 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. Subsequent bounces deal (60/95/130 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slow by 20% for 1 second. Zac gains up to 50% Move Speed over time and can cast Unstable Matter while bouncing. Total Damage: (300/475/650 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage Move Speed increases from 20% to 50% over the duration. During Let's Bounce!, Zac is Ghosted. Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.
